problem_statement: The bit-set type needs to support richer operations than the current read/modify of individual bits. A program that wants to ask how many bits are set, whether one set is a subset or superset of another, complement a set, or combine two sets via union, intersection, or subtraction, and to inspect or copy the underlying byte mask, has no such functionality. Provide a bit-set class that supports querying the element count and total bit count, comparing sets by subset/superset relations, complementing, unioning, intersecting, subtracting, reading and writing the raw byte mask, while preserving the existing per-bit add/remove/has/update/empty behavior.
